```sql
select
  NULL as key,
  count(distinct o.order_id) as value
from orders o
join showrooms s on s.showroom_id = o.showroom_id
join payment_attempts a on a.order_id = o.order_id
where not o.is_test
  and not a.is_test
  and s.country_code in ('GB')
  and o.business_date between date '2026-08-01' and date '2026-08-31'
  and a.method = 'pay_later'
  and a.status = 'captured'
order by value
```
